tape: The default CSP screen returned 20 names with one correlation cluster (SATL+BKSY, 0.84), so 20 rows are 19 bets.
17 of 20 use the Nov 20 expiry. TMPro's earnings calendar only runs to Nov 10, and it lists reports for RBLX and OUST inside that expiry. The screen marked both clear.
Only 2 of 20 names carry an IV rank (52-week, CBOE): SMMT 27 and AGIO 23. The other 18 have none.
Seven quotes are wide: SLS, FCEL, SATL, ABTC, FRVO, ABSI, NN. ABTC and NN traded 0 contracts, AGIO 1.
BW, FRVO, GRRR and CLPT have strikes under their 60-day low, because all four are making new lows. CAPR's 7 strike sits 136% above its 60-day low.
Gamma scan: 18 of 25 names in positive dealer gamma (pinning), 7 in negative (moves get amplified).

setups.management: Close at 50% of credit. If 16 closes broken, take assignment at a 14.22 basis or roll down and out.
